act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: Hello, everyone. It is my great pleasure to have you here for Theater Open Day! Please join me in giving a warm welcome to the prima ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe, Odette!
(Applause)
Hello.
Whoa, she's not smiling, even at a time like this.
Ah, but you see, that's where Miss Odette's charm lies!
Thank you for that warm reception. Now then, straight to business...
Let's talk about the upcoming ballet I'm sure we're all eagerly anticipating — the "Black Snow Swan"!
It is, as you may know, an adaptation of a literary classic.
Through the story of an extraordinary black snow swan, the ballet explores the relationship between the individual and the collective as well as the eternal question of fate.
I'd like to take this opportunity to ask you, Miss Odette, on behalf of our audience... What are your thoughts on this work?
It's a fantastic work. Interpreting it as a ballet has proved difficult...
...But it's worth it.
A most concise insight, Miss Odette.
I'm sure everyone's curious about the effort that lies behind this seemingly understated conclusion. Could you share a bit more?
Everyone in the company gives their all to each performance. I'm no more hardworking than them.
But the Black Snow Swan does hold a special meaning to me personally, so I will make sure to do my very best.
Oh, splendid! We'll leave the remaining time for questions from the audience...
The lady in blue over there — your question, please.
I heard you added a lot of difficult steps to the choreography, and even intend to challenge the record for the most consecutive fouettes performed onstage... Is that true?
Yes.
I believe it's well within my current capabilities.
What Snezhnaya needs is revitalization. Instead of promoting these performances, shouldn't celebrities lead by example and do some actual work instead?
Huh? What kind of question is that...? Is he trying to pick a fight?
As a prima ballerina, I respect our artistic traditions, and I use ballet to express my love and care for our land.
I also hope those who watch my performances can find the strength to defy fate through art. That includes you, sir.
Miss Odette! What are the key characteristics of the Black Snow Swan to you?
Solitude, nobility... Even at the cost of her own life, she refuses to bow down to fate.
Thank you, Miss Odette. Are there any other questions from the audience?
Miss Odette! How many hours a day do you spend training, and what does that entail?
Miss Odette! What kind of music do you listen to during dance practice?

dialogue.sit: The passionate questions continue, causing the event to end thirty minutes past schedule.

dialogue.t: Phew...
Something wrong, Odette? Paimon thought your answers were great. Your fans are so passionate!
It was tiring, but...
But?
Seeing how excited and passionate they all were, even after the event ended... I'm even more determined to make this performance a good one.

dialogue.sit: (Looks like she really meant what she said at the meet-and-greet...)

dialogue.t: Well, we believe in you! We're done for the day, so you should head back early and get some rest!
No need. I'm going to head to the studio to do some extra practice. I'll leave once I'm tired.

dialogue.sit: So this is what it's like to work with a celebrity...

dialogue.t: Hah...
In this instance, I do believe the talent knows best.
